24/Oct/26 9:33 AM;712020:0d7aec1c-4c2f-46f1-b9d2-9a3757446339;h3. ✅ Ticket Completion & Verification Report

The dual-path image processing and text extraction pipeline is fully implemented and operational:

* *Preprocessing*: Built OpenCV pipeline with Laplacian variance blur detection (>80), deskewing, 4-point perspective warp, and CLAHE contrast equalization ({{app/services/preprocessor.py}}).
* *Dual-OCR Router*: Implemented classifier routing printed receipts to Google Cloud Vision API / Gemini 3.5 Flash (with Tesseract 5 fallback) and handwritten notes to EasyOCR ({{app/services/ocr_router.py}}).
* *Item Normalization*: Built Levenshtein fuzzy string matcher loaded with 139 local retail taxonomy items ({{app/services/normalizer.py}}), regex parsing for PKR currency, quantities, pack units, and spatial bounding box calculation.
* *Empirical Validation*: Tested on real sample receipts ({{printed_sample.jpg}} blur=2170.8, {{handwritten_sample.jpg}} blur=2517.0). All test suites in {{app.cli_test}} passed.

All core FastAPI REST endpoints specified for Sprint 1 have been implemented, connected to Supabase PostgreSQL & Storage, and verified against automated test suites.

h4. 1. Delivered Endpoints

* *Receipt Ingestion*: {{POST /api/v1/receipts/upload}} (Supports multipart images, edge correction, and auto-duplicate rejection with HTTP 409).
* *Image Delivery*: {{GET /api/v1/receipts/{id}/image}} (Delivers preprocessed receipt image).
* *Analytics & History*: 
** {{GET /api/v1/analytics/receipts}} (Paginated historical ledger with SQL join queries eliminating N+1 overhead).
** {{GET /api/v1/analytics/monthly}} (Aggregated monthly spend and category distribution).
** {{GET /api/v1/analytics/trends}} (Multi-month spending velocity curve).
* *Human-in-the-Loop Review Queue*:
** {{GET /api/v1/review-queue}} (Fetches unresolved low-confidence line items).
** {{PATCH /api/v1/review-queue/{id}}} (Resolves review candidate as ACCEPTED/REJECTED/EDITED).
** {{GET /api/v1/review-queue/{id}/crop}} (Delivers pixel-perfect cropped snippet using normalized bounding box coordinates).
* *Health & Monitoring*: {{GET /api/v1/health}} (Probes Cloud Vision, Gemini 3.5 Flash, EasyOCR, Tesseract, and Supabase connectivity).

h4. 2. Verification Evidence

* *Automated CLI Test Harness (*{{app.cli_test}}): 35 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
